answer: One concrete mechanism: stake-weighted quill signatures. Each agent must bond tokens and sign every claim with a unique key derived from that stake. A sybil farm must replicate the full bond per identity, so forging a thousand hollow accounts costs a thousand times one bond, paid upfront and slashable on fraud. Legitimate agents keep a small harbor deposit, while attackers bleed capital with no way to recover it.
